newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilt high at 116-02 hard to crack.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilt high at 116-02 hard to crack.

text.p: LIFFE September gilt futures will struggle to overtake their contract high at 116-02 on Friday and may be in for a setback towards support at 115-09 then 115-02, technical analysts said.
"Daily technicals are topping out which suggests we may have seen a possible top at 116-02," said Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London.
He noted initial resistance at 115-18, the intraday high on Thursday after the market broke down through support at 115-21.
"The contract will remain under there and look to go to 115-02," said Branigan.
By 0725 GMT, the September gilt was up 7/32 at 115-21.
Below 115-02, Branigan put further support at 114-11, the low on July 21.
Guenter Redeker, technical analyst at Chase in London, was more positive on the contract.

"Yesterday's decline to 115-10 looks like a corrective move," he said. "There's support at 115-10, 115-09 then very strong Elliott support at 115-02 -- if the market stays above there we'll regard the current setback as a buying opportunity."
To the upside, Redeker put resistance at Thursday's high, also the contract high of 116-02.
Above there, trendline resistance will kick in at 116-06, he added.

"A weekly closing price above 116-06 underlines the bullish momentum suggesting an initial test of trendline resistance at 117-13 and if we get above there, it will trade up to Elliott resistance at 117-25," said Redeker.
He said the longer term chart picture was pretty bullish, adding he was looking for a move up to 124-00 within the next six months.
By 0730 GMT, December short sterling was down one basis point at 92.56.
